As Veterans Day approaches, that milestone gives us a chance to look at how veterans are using AI to prepa

en.reason: More than 20,000 transitioning servicemembers and veterans have claimed a year of free ChatGPT Plus from OpenAI, while OpenAI Academy has trained nearly 1,000 military community members across 10-plus sessions, with seven more planned by year-end.

sources.summary:
A Blog post by QVAC on Hugging Face
A Blog post by QVAC on Hugging Face
Frontier cloud LLMs carry high operational costs that can fluctuate unexpectedly, and relying on such third-party models introduces vulnerabilities, as providers can modify, deny, or deprecate access at any time. Furthermore, proprietary models offer limited customization for specific workflows, while posing risks to privacy, data control, and transparency. Besides, not every task demands frontier-level intelligence: small,
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Tether AI Research 推出基于 Qwen3.5-0.8B 的 0.8B 参数 BotPsy 端侧助理，主打函数调用与代理工作流，测试中胜过不超过 1.2B 参数模型。

en.reason: Tether AI Research’s 0.8B-parameter BotPsy, built on Qwen3.5-0.8B for on-device function calling and agentic workflows, outperforms models with up to 1.2B parameters in the blog’s tests.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 2026年12月8日起，GitHub 将暂停过去一年无活动仓库的 Dependabot alerts，现有告警归档不删除，任意 push 可自动恢复并重置一年计时。

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 11月10日Adobe MAX 2026上，Photoshop的Relight可凭空加光源并调位置颜色亮度，Remove能连倒影脚印一并清除并重建背景，Adobe还预览MCP计划2027年初让第三方AI代理直接操作Photoshop等项目。

en.title: Adobe MAX pulls out the stops: Photoshop can now relight scenes and clean up reflections, and Adobe wants AI agents to take control of its software
en.reason: At Adobe MAX 2026 on November 10, Adobe showed Photoshop's Relight adding and adjusting a light source, Remove clearing reflections and footprints while rebuilding backgrounds, and a previewed MCP plan for third-party AI agents to operate Photoshop by early 2027.

items.title: 信息量更大的GitHub dashboard / A more informative GitHub dashboard

sources.title: 信息量更大的GitHub dashboard / A more informative GitHub dashboard
sources.title_zh: 信息量更大的GitHub dashboard
sources.title_original: A more informative GitHub dashboard
sources.recommend_reason_zh: GitHub 新 dashboard 因宽松内边距、换行标题和低默认条目数被开发者反馈“占空间多、信息少”，本次更新将其改得更紧凑易扫，并让无可用会话时的 Agent sessions 不再显示。

en.reason: GitHub's dashboard update makes the layout more compact and scannable after developers complained that generous padding, wrapped titles and a low default item count showed too little, and it no longer displays Agent sessions when none are available.
